0.original: Rhalgr's Reach is no longer safe, as Pipin well knows.

25.original: Search the infirmary for medical supplies.

26.original: Give the medical supplies to the Flame courier.

50.original: I'll recover. My injuries aren't serious─though that was clearly by choice and not happenstance. They meant to take me alive.

51.original: You're worried about Y'shtola, aren't you? <sigh> It's too early to make any kind of prognosis, but...she's alive. For now.

52.original: If it wasn't for her, it'd be me lying there...<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>...I wish it was.<hex:021A020103>

54.original: Our defeat was no near thing. It was total─a humiliation. We were powerless to withstand our enemy's assault.

55.original: But we cannot afford to dwell on our failure. As Alphinaud said, it is those who survived whom we must think of now.

56.original: Rhalgr's Reach is no longer safe. The imperials may have withdrawn, but they could return at any time to finish what they began. We dare not remain here.

57.original: Those who are not fit to make the journey to Castrum Oriens will need to be taken by chocobo carriage. Agreed?

58.original: Good. I shall oversee preparations for the carriages. In the meantime, I would have you scour the infirmary for any supplies that might prove useful during the journey.

59.original: Forgive me, but it is imperative that I continue preparing medicines for the wounded. If you desire treatment, I must ask that you seek it elsewhere.

60.original: Oh, I see... In that case, you are free to search the Barber and take that which you require. I would not have our people dying en route.

61.original: I would assist you, but this process demands my undivided attention.

62.original: Take whatever you require for your needs. I will replenish the stock after.

64.original: We're to move the wounded to Castrum Oriens? Understood. I'll go and see if anyone requires assistance.

65.original: I will accompany Commander Kemp in one of the carriages.

66.original: No, no, I'd hate to be a burden...

67.original: We'll need to carry Y'shtola to the carriage. Could you give me a hand, Lyse?

68.original: As if you need to ask!

70.original: Twelve be praised. This should put the drivers' hearts at ease. Tell the vice marshal we await his orders.

74.original: Y'shtola and the others are safely strapped in. Don't worry─I'll be by her side the entire time.

76.original: I'll walk alongside. They'll need protection in case the Garleans try anything.

77.original: Hang on. You're injured too, aren't you? Shouldn't you be in one of the carriages?

78.original: I'm not so frail that I can't make the trip on my own. Besides, there's still work to be done here. I'll see you at the Wall when it's finished.

79.original: As you wish. Then let us set forth at once. We shall move as quickly as our comrades' health allows.
